direct_source_reads.finding: Copy-on-write sparse tiles, bounded chunk/sink GPU structure and dependency separation are reuse candidates. Self-generated roundtrips and renderer tolerances are not independent Adobe parity proof.

Curve-preserving sweep topology through linesweeper and kurbo, fill-rule winding and refit tolerance are concrete reuse candidates; adopt only through canonical Nib geometry/types and declared precision.
Composition exposes shaping, line breaking, columns/threading/wrap and overset. IDML manifest uses quick-xml/zip. Availability is not proof of RTL/CJK, native INDD or a complete IDML mapping.
Non-destructive recipe package and scalar CFA neighborhood algorithm are useful references. Decoder/model/process-version coverage and integrated catalogs are not proven.
Redaction sanitizer selects hidden payload classes and forces full rewrite to discard prior revisions. Whole reachable payload and independent saved-byte verification remain necessary.

adobe_manuals.use: PSD/PSB versioned sections, channel/resource/layer structures; detailed unsupported fields remain explicit.
Separate multilingual composition workflow rather than proving Arabic/Hebrew through Latin frame reflow.
Kinsoku-specific line-breaking cases; CJK is not satisfied by generic Unicode acceptance.
World-Ready composition is a distinct parity surface requiring pinned font/script/source output.
Separations and overprint preview need distinct output observations; screen preview alone cannot prove all physical print properties.
Catalog workflow includes external assets/auxiliary files and develop context; count/parser success cannot establish complete semantics.

proposal_policy.path_rule: Relative file suggestions below are proposed responsibility paths under each existing owner root, not assertions that files exist. Exact coordinator allocation and renewed template publication precede contract edits.
proposal_policy.types_rule: Use exact canonical Accord/Folio types/IDs/units; descriptions below are semantic input/output requirements, not authorization to invent schemas or port names.
proposal_policy.feature_rule: All proposed packages use --no-default-features. Provider feature names/pins must bind actual materialized Cargo declarations before coding dispatch; proposals never assume names exist.
proposal_policy.compile_method: Implementer: cargo check --locked --tests -p <selected canonical package> --no-default-features with the exact approved provider feature set; selected-package dependency/static check excludes forbidden closure. No command run here.
proposal_policy.runtime_method: Independent validator: one checked-in runner/config union invocation for selected packages and exact named cases below, bounded per test. Root binds actual runner and feature syntax; no runtime env/flag invention.
proposal_policy.timeouts: Proposed per-case wall limits below are proof-run configuration, not product parameter limits. Large real resources need separately declared bounded cases, not silently extended timeouts.
proposal_policy.controls: Every inspector/tool panel uses configured Controls descriptors. Root/Controls owner extends missing canonical mechanics; no duplicate panel/control asset.
proposal_policy.host_phase: Asset outputs are immutable proposals/results. Actual grants, sandbox/promotion, CKC, CRDT, SurrealDB/EventLedger, FR, Argus/native and manual consumer acceptance remain separately mandatory phase2 with exact host owner.
proposal_policy.diagnostics: Bind same command/state descriptor to Observe, existing manual and Controls/Argus adapters; revision/profile/provenance on images. Do not duplicate diagnostic/manual authority.

representative_proposals.algorithm: Copy-on-write affected tiles; intersect stroke/mask damage with tile bounds; compute immutable patch and inverse preimage, no full-frame allocation or authority write.
representative_proposals.inputs: Canonical tile sample format/channel order/profile, integer pixel rectangles, mask coverage, target/property revision, cancel epoch and byte lease.
representative_proposals.outputs: Typed tile patch, exact damaged rectangle, inverse bytes, profile/revision receipt and loss/error outcome.
representative_proposals.provider: Photocraft raster candidate adapted through Accord/Prism; CPU-only, GPU/codec excluded.
representative_proposals.oracle: Independent hand-computed tiny mask/sample matrices plus original-produced blend/brush corpus for feature parity; exact preimage digest unchanged on reject.
representative_proposals.gap: Bind sample formats and every raster command's exact fields; MT021 host conformance is not asset-foundation acceptance.

representative_proposals.algorithm: Normalize canonical paths, sweep curve intersections with winding rules, reconstruct contours/refit only within declared precision; preserve fill/stroke provenance.
representative_proposals.inputs: Canonical path/network IDs, anchors/handles in document points, fill rule, transform, exact precision classification, revision and cancellation.
representative_proposals.outputs: Editable paths/network patch, topology and approximation/loss receipt; immutable original.
representative_proposals.provider: Vectorcraft pathops/linesweeper/kurbo candidates; inspect exact transitive pins before adoption, no raster editor dependency.
representative_proposals.oracle: Independent analytic overlap area/winding plus original Illustrator-produced edited paths and reopening; do not merely compare two uses of same sweep kernel.
representative_proposals.gap: Tolerance/default differs from upstream; must use spec exact field or unknown, not import upstream 0.01 silently.

representative_proposals.algorithm: Resolve shared Type shaping, paragraph breaks, columns/baselines/wrap and threaded frames; return overset spans. Component responsive constraints remain Components collaboration.
representative_proposals.inputs: Canonical stories/frame chain and font fingerprints, language/script/direction, page-point measurements, grid/wrap and revision footprints.
representative_proposals.outputs: Placed glyph/frame ranges, overset/preflight findings and revision-bound layout proposal.
representative_proposals.provider: Designcraft compose candidate through Type/Nib contracts; no duplicate shaping or component solver owner.
representative_proposals.oracle: InDesign-produced exact story/font/settings fixtures with line/glyph/frame-position and overset comparison. Separate pinned RTL/CJK cases; Latin proof cannot cover them.
representative_proposals.gap: Read implementation modules for each language capability and bind font resources; provider headline coverage does not prove multilingual parity.
